cats.name: Meredith Grey
cats.story: Meredith Grey is Taylor Swift's Scottish Fold, adopted in late 2011 and named after the Grey's Anatomy lead. She appeared in Swift's Diet Coke and Keds ads and is famous for her aloof, 'sassy' posture. People reported her rare 2025 appearance after Swift bought back her masters.
cats.look: A silver classic tabby-and-white Scottish Fold female with tightly folded ears flat on a round head, a short dense plush coat and a compact cobby body. Bold black swirls cover her crown, with dark stripes between the ears, plus her ears, back, flanks, hips and ringed tail; dark mascara lines run from her big round pale yellow-green eyes. Pure white covers her lower face between and below the eyes, chin, throat, chest, belly and all four legs, and her pink nose has small grey freckles. Her signature is an aloof, half-lidded 'sassy' upright stare.

cats.name: Benjamin Button
cats.story: Benjamin Button is Taylor Swift's Ragdoll, introduced in her 2019 'ME!' video and draped over her shoulders on TIME's 2023 Person of the Year cover. Swift joked on X: 'Can I bring my cat.'
cats.look: A cream-and-white seal bicolour Ragdoll, a large, soft adult male with a semi-long silky coat, a fluffy ruff and pale cream to fawn-grey shading on his back and sides. His ears are dark seal-brown, and his seal-brown mask covers only the eye area and upper cheeks, split by a broad white inverted V from a narrow mid-forehead blaze over his nose and muzzle. His chin, chest, belly, legs and paws are all pure white, his tail a dark seal-brown plume, and he has vivid blue eyes and a pink nose. He drapes over Taylor Swift's shoulders on TIME's 2023 cover.

cats.name: Larry
cats.story: Larry, a brown-and-white tabby from Battersea, has been Chief Mouser to the Cabinet Office at 10 Downing Street since February 2011, outlasting several Prime Ministers; CBS reported him awaiting his seventh PM in 2026.
cats.look: A brown tabby-and-white domestic shorthair male of lean, medium build, with a cool grey-brown coat, black mackerel and classic stripes on his crown, ears, cheeks, back and flanks, and a dark-ringed, black-tipped tail. A narrow white blaze runs up his nose bridge onto his forehead, and his muzzle, chin, throat, chest, belly, front legs and all four paws are white. A dark tabby patch sits mid-chest and a dark stripe crosses his white shoulder; he has greenish-gold eyes and a pink nose. He usually sits on the step of the black door of 10 Downing Street.

cats.name: Choupette
cats.story: Choupette is the blue-cream Birman of fashion designer Karl Lagerfeld, who called her 'the center of the world'. She had two maids, travelled by private jet, starred in campaigns (Shu Uemura, Hublot) and was named among his heirs. The Atlantic and Telegraph covered her life after his 2019 death.
cats.look: A white Birman female with a long, silky, almost entirely white-to-ivory coat, a full white ruff and very pale, warm colourpoints. She is a blue-cream point: her ears and faint mask are soft cream to apricot-peach mottled with pale blue-grey, greyest on the nose bridge, and her plumed tail is pale cream with light blue-grey mottling. She has white Birman gloves on all four paws, light sapphire-blue eyes and a dusky pink-grey nose. Her signature is lounging on luxury cushions amid Paris and private-jet glamour.

cats.name: Maru
cats.story: Maru, a Scottish Straight from Japan, rose to fame in 2008 diving into cardboard boxes; Guinness recognised him in 2016 as YouTube's most-viewed animal. He died in September 2025 aged 18.
cats.look: A grey tabby-and-white Scottish Straight male, grey-brown in tone, with a stocky, very chubby round body, a broad round face, a short dense coat and upright, unfolded ears. Bold black stripes mark his forehead M, ears, eye rims, cheeks, back, flanks and ringed tail. A narrow white blaze runs up his nose bridge, and his muzzle, lower cheeks, chin, throat, chest bib, belly and all four feet are white; he has large round yellow-green eyes and a pink nose. His signature prop is a too-small cardboard box he squeezes into, head and upper body spilling over.

cats.name: Bob
cats.story: Bob was a ginger stray who adopted busker James Bowen in London in 2007; their story became the bestseller A Street Cat Named Bob and two films in which Bob played himself. He died in 2020; a bronze statue stands in Islington.
cats.look: A ginger mackerel tabby, a large, stocky domestic shorthair male with a rich orange coat, darker orange stripes forming a clear M and lines over his crown, striped cheeks, flanks and legs, and a ringed tail. His muzzle, chin and throat are pale cream-white and his chest creamy; he has green eyes, yellow-green in some light, and a pink nose. His signature is a hand-knitted red wool scarf with a white Fair Isle pattern of reindeer and snowflakes, as on the 2016 film poster. He rides on James Bowen's shoulder or sits on his backpack while he busks.

cats.name: Meowth
cats.story: Meowth is the Scratch Cat Pokémon (#052); the Team Rocket Meowth who taught himself to talk and walk upright has been a main anime character since 1997. Nintendo and The Pokémon Company regularly feature the Jessie-James-Meowth trio.
cats.look: A cream cartoon cat in the official Pokémon anime and game style, smooth and cel-shaded, standing on all four legs like a real cat, with a large ovoid head and a long thin tail whose brown tip curls tightly. His ears are black with brown insides, a gold oval koban coin with horizontal lines sits in his forehead, and two long whisker spikes stick out on each side of his face, with two more rising by his ears. He has wide white eyes with black slit pupils, two small upper fangs and a sly grin, cream front paws and brown-tipped hind paws.

cats.name: Lil BUB
cats.story: Lil BUB (2011–2019) was the 'magical space cat' with dwarfism, extra toes and a permanently protruding tongue, cared for by Mike Bridavsky; she raised over $700,000 for pets and starred in Lil Bub & Friendz (2013).
cats.look: A grey-brown mackerel tabby female, tiny even as an adult from extreme dwarfism, with a kitten-sized body, very short stubby legs and a waddling gait. Bold black stripes mark her forehead M, cheeks, back and legs, her tail is ringed, her muzzle and chin are cream-white and her chest buff-cream. Her white feet are broad with extra toes, and her huge, wide-set yellow-green eyes bulge slightly from a broad flat face. A very short, toothless lower jaw leaves her small pink tongue always sticking out, often against a starry 'magical space cat' sky.

cats.name: Kitty Purry
cats.story: Kitty Purry was a pregnant stray who crawled through a window to Katy Perry's then-boyfriend around 2005; she became Perry's grey tabby, appeared in the 'I Kissed a Girl' (2008) video and lent her name to the fan club. Perry tweeted 'KITTY PURRY IS A CAT'; she died in April 2020, aged about 15.
cats.look: A brown mackerel tabby female moggy with a medium-to-long, fluffy, Maine-Coon-like coat on a warm tan-fawn ground, a plush ruff, long ear furnishings with slight tufts and a medium build. Dark brown-black stripes form a bold M with forehead lines and dark cheek bars, and warm fawn rings her yellow-gold to amber eyes and muzzle. Her chin and muzzle edges are white, a fluffy white ruff spreads over her throat and chest toward her cheeks, and her front paws are white mittens. She has a brick-pink nose with a dark rim and a heavy-lidded, grumpy squint.

cats.name: Delilah
cats.story: Delilah was Freddie Mercury's favourite of his many cats at Garden Lodge, London. He wrote the Queen song 'Delilah' (Innuendo, 1991) about her, and Sotheby's featured his cats in its 2023 Mercury auction.

White covers her muzzle, a blaze up the centre of her face, her chin, throat, chest, belly and all four legs. Solid black patches cover both ears and the eye area like a mask split by the blaze, with a small ginger patch atop her forehead, big black and ginger patches on her back, flanks, hindquarters and tail. She has gold-green to yellow eyes, a pink nose and a yellow or orange collar with a tag.

cats.name: Willow
cats.story: Willow is a grey tabby farm cat who jumped on stage during Jill Biden's 2020 campaign speech in Pennsylvania. She moved into the White House in January 2022 as First Cat, named after Willow Grove, PA.

cats.name: Gli
cats.story: Gli (2004–2020) was the tabby born at Hagia Sophia who lived there for 16 years; Barack Obama petted her on a 2009 visit. Reuters covered her fame; she died in November 2020 and was buried on the grounds.
cats.look: A brown mackerel tabby all over, a sturdy, fairly large female domestic shorthair, golden-tawny to grey-brown, who grew chunky in later years. Bold black stripes run down her flanks and legs, with a strong tabby M and forehead lines, dark cheek bars and a banded, dark-tipped tail. Her chest, underside and paws are buff tabby with no white bib or paws; only her whisker pads, lips and chin are cream-white, plus a small pale patch low on the belly. Her signature green to yellow-green eyes are slightly crossed, and her nose is brick-pink with a dark rim.

cats.name: Tombili
cats.story: Tombili was a chubby Istanbul street cat famous for lounging against a step with one paw draped; after her 2016 death a bronze statue of her pose was placed in Kadıköy, stolen and recovered.

cats.name: Tama
cats.story: Tama, a calico stray, was made stationmaster of unstaffed Kishi Station in 2007; tourism boosted the struggling Kishigawa Line. She was promoted to 'super stationmaster' and VP, and after her 2015 death was enshrined as 'Honourable Eternal Stationmaster'.

cats.name: The Cat Gatekeeper cat
cats.owner: ZOKUZOKU / ぞくぞく, indie developer of the Cat Gatekeeper browser extension and desktop app (@konekone2026)
cats.story: The star of Cat Gatekeeper, a free browser extension by Japanese developer ZOKUZOKU (@konekone2026). Spend too long on social media and a giant, chubby orange tabby strolls onto your screen, plops down in front of your feed and stays until the break timer runs out. At launch there was no way to shoo it away; a later update lets you dismiss it early by pressing and holding a button for about three seconds. The launch post on 26 Apr 2026 ("I made a kitty forced-break app! Use social media too much and the kitty appears and takes over your screen") went viral on X, and Dexerto covered it the same day. Digital Trends and Popular Science wrote about it soon after. The official site now reports over 300,000 users, plus a Firefox version and a desktop app. The cat has no official name; the creator just calls it "kitty" (猫ちゃん). The site says its cats are "ideal cats created with the help of AI".
cats.look: A photo-realistic (AI-assisted) giant, very chubby orange/ginger mackerel tabby. Darker orange stripes run across the forehead, cheeks, flanks and legs. The chin, chest, belly and paws are white. Amber/olive-gold eyes, often sleepily half-closed, and a pink nose. It wears a dark grey collar with a small silver bell. A huge round belly: it slumps back on one hip with its belly out and a hind leg stretched forward,, filling the screen in front of the social feed.

cats.name: Zelda
cats.story: Zelda was a black-and-white London rescue cat. Matt Taghioff adopted her from the Mayhew rescue shelter in 2014; at first she hid under the sofa, watching him with an unblinking stare and spooking at the slightest noise. As @CuriousZelda ('Hunter of house flies and keeper of string. Easily startled. Often caught staring. Author of book.') she won fans with her startled look and her rhyming posts, such as her 2023 rhyme 'Will Twitter be toast? / Has everyone fled? / It's high time I shared / A Thread about bread'. With more than 80,000 followers she won a book deal at auction: 'The Adventures of a Curious Cat' (Sphere, an imprint of Little, Brown, 2019). Zelda died peacefully at home in 2024. Matt's farewell post thanked fans for their poems, memes and fan art.

Black nose, long white whiskers, upright black ears and a compact, loaf-shaped build; sometimes a tiny pink tongue blep. No accessories.

cats.name: Gregory

cats.story: Astrophotographer Andrew McCarthy adopted Gregory from an animal shelter in Sep 2024. His post said he took home "the cat with the saddest eyes at the shelter" (20.6M views). A day later he posted: "Sad eyes are gone." On the first anniversary McCarthy wrote that Gregory had been the oldest cat and the longest resident, and is now "a sassy, talkative friend who sits with me while I take photos of space." He photographed Gregory against his space images for the Cosmic Gregory 2026 calendar: basking under the Sun, toying with Saturn and 'representing the solar system' (PetaPixel). He shared the proceeds with the shelter, and on 5 Nov 2025 he donated $10k to Gregory's former shelter. On 5 Sep 2026 he announced that the Cosmic Gregory calendar returns for 2027, with Gregory meeting 'other life forms': fans' cats.
cats.look: A fluffy long-haired orange (ginger) tabby male with a thick cream-white ruff and bib. Darker ginger tabby stripes run across his forehead and cheeks. His muzzle and chin are cream-white and his nose is pink. His amber-gold eyes looked droopy and sad in the shelter carrier photo. His ears are tufted with long pale furnishings, and he has long white whiskers, a plumed tail and a sturdy, heavily furred build. Later photos show a dark collar. PetaPixel (Oct 2025) quotes the vet's estimate that he is 4-5 years old.

proof.author: AJamesMcCarthy
proof.text: I’ve felt a void in my life ever since my cat passed last year so I went and adopted the cat with the saddest eyes at the shelter. Hopefully he likes Bailey and astronomy and I can give him happy eyes 🥺

cats.name: Maruo
cats.story: Maruo (まるお) is the male Scottish Fold of Japanese YouTuber HIKAKIN, born on 25 May 2018 and living with him since 19 July 2018. Japanese Wikipedia says he was named for his round face and for being a boy. That September HIKAKIN also took in Mofuko (もふこ), Maruo's sister born the same day, so the separated siblings could live together again (youtube-walker). His one-photo post '本日のまるお🐈 冬の毛になってきた✨' ('Today's Maruo, his winter coat is coming in', October 2023) reached 101,043 likes and 20.3 million views. For the pair's 7th birthday in May 2025, HIKAKIN built them a giant cardboard castle.
cats.look: An orange-and-white (red bicolour) Scottish Fold with a round, full-cheeked face. His small ears fold forward and lie flat against his head. His head, cheeks and back are orange with soft darker orange tabby stripes on the forehead and cheeks. A white blaze runs from the forehead down between the eyes to a white muzzle. His chin, chest and front legs and paws are white. He has large round amber-gold eyes and a pink nose, a stocky, rounded build, and a dense plush coat that thickens in winter. No collar. His sister Mofuko is also an orange Scottish Fold, named for being very fluffy.

cats.name: Neko-sama
cats.owner: Hidekichi Matsumoto (松本ひで吉, @hidekiccan), manga artist, With a Dog AND a Cat, Every Day is Fun
cats.story: Neko-sama ('Lord Cat') was the real cat of manga artist Hidekichi Matsumoto and co-star of With a Dog AND a Cat, Every Day is Fun, which began on her Twitter in February 2017. The first comic (5 Feb 2017) set the joke: the angelic dog hopes for snacks, while the cat, drawn with a deliberately fearsome glare, scoffs at him and raids the food after everyone is asleep. Kodansha (July 2019): her followers grew from about 3,000 to about 330,000, the first print run of 37,000 sold out on day one, and the cumulative print run had passed 500,000; a TV anime aired Oct 2020 to Mar 2021. Neko-sama and the dog Inu-kun were close like brothers; both lived to 13, and the artist said goodbye to the cat in February 2023.
cats.look: Real cat, drawn in loose ink manga style. A stout white cat with dark grey-black patches: two dark patches on top of the head between the ears like a split cap, a dark smudge over the nose and muzzle, a dark spot on the back or saddle and one on the hip, and a dark tail with faint bands. Narrow, heavy-lidded glaring eyes (Kodansha's editor says the artist drew him with an impossibly frightening face), small ears, and a round loaf-like body. The real photo inset in the first comic shows a white cat with a black smudge across the nose and light eyes.

cats.name: Ollie
cats.owner: Ricky Gervais (comedian) and his partner Jane Fallon (author)
cats.story: Ollie was Ricky Gervais's Siamese cat. His friend Jonathan Ross gave her to him as a surprise when Ricky appeared on Ross's TV show in 2003, and she was named after Ricky's comedy hero Oliver Hardy (NZ Herald). She had her own Twitter account, @myleftfang, whose bio shouts 'ME ME ME ME ME ... TELL ME I'M A GOOD GIRL!'. When Ricky posted 'Just had to say goodbye to the sweetest little soul I've ever known. RIP Ollie July 9th 2003 - March 10th 2020', fans rushed to Twitter with condolences and Ollie trended on the platform (Radio X). Jane Fallon called her a 'smart, funny, feisty, beautiful sidekick'. Her account lives on: in October 2020 it posted 'I APPROVE!!! LOOK AFTER MY MUM PICKLE!' and on 9 July 2021, 'TODAY WOULD HAVE BEEN MY 18TH BIRTHDAY!!!'.
cats.look: Seal-point Siamese. Her body is pale cream to ivory, and her points are a very dark seal brown: a full face mask covering the whole face, large upright pointed ears and a long dark tail. Her front legs are shaded a lighter fawn-brown. There is a small white fleck on the bridge of her nose between the eyes, and her eyes are blue. In her 18th-birthday photo she is mid-yowl with her mouth wide open and fangs showing, which fits her handle 'myleftfang'. No collar or accessories.

cats.name: Patches
cats.story: Patches is the cat of Minecraft YouTuber Dream, and his short posts about her are fan favourites on X. 'it's patches 128th birthday today :D' (October 2020) drew 83,017 likes, and 'happy birthday patches' with a photo of her curled up in a cat-tree bed (February 2025) drew 14,915. In June 2021 he opened a side account just for her, @dreamsecretclub. Dexerto reported it passed 116,000 followers with only a few photos before he set it to private, while fans filled the 'patches' search on Twitter with pictures of the 'tortoiseshell kitty'. In 2025 he admitted: 'how do I make patches like the other cats I've given up'.

Her coat is dark brown-black tabby striping mixed with rust-ginger patches, with the most ginger across her back and flanks. Her face is brown tabby with warm tones. Her muzzle and chin are white. She has green-gold eyes and brown ears with pink insides. No collar is visible. In the 2025 photo she is curled up in a round grey plush cat-tree bed with her tail wrapped over her paws.

cats.name: Ponta
cats.story: Ponta (ぽんた) is the real male mixed-breed cat of manga diarist Tsuyoshi Konoike (@TsuyoshiWood). He stars in the one-page diary comics that made Konoike's following explode on Twitter. A friend found him as an abandoned kitten and pushed Konoike to take him, and his old name 'Nonta' became Ponta. He won't warm to strangers at all and scratches his owner often. His housemate Alfred, found hurt in the bushes behind the house, is gentle. The comics became the book series 鴻池剛と猫のぽんた ニャアアアン! (Kadokawa/Enterbrain, vol. 1 Oct 2015, vol. 4 Feb 2026) and two LINE sticker sets. Konoike's site marked Ponta's 14th birthday on 15 Sep 2025. In a 26 Aug 2026 comic his vet marvels that he gained 100 g and still runs and jumps despite long-term kidney disease, and then, held by the nurses for an ear cleaning, Ponta lands a swat on a hand.
cats.look: As drawn in Konoike's bold, clean manga style with flat colour: a big, round, heavy-set, thick-furred cat. His back, head and tail are a warm caramel-brown. A white blaze runs down the middle of the face and widens into a white muzzle, and his chest, belly and paws are white. Small rounded ears and narrow, half-lidded glaring eyes give him a permanently grumpy, unimpressed face. In the 2023 surgery comics he wears a pink cone collar. Konoike says the real cat (a brown tabby-and-white) looks quite different from the simplified drawing, so follow the comic design.

cats.name: Rolf
cats.owner: Helen Bevan, Robb Corrigan and family (live near the University of Warwick campus)
cats.story: Rolf is the University of Warwick's campus cat; Wikipedia's Warwick article says the university 'has a campus cat named Rolf'. He lives with his family (Helen Bevan, Robb Corrigan and family) near campus and calls himself an 'Ambassacat for student health & wellbeing', with #RelaxWithRolf on Fridays. His X account was set up to track his movements across campus and tell students where to find him for a quick meet-up (The Boar). On 7 March 2021 hackers took over the account and replaced his daily updates with posts including a protest about bitcoin. The #CatsOfTwitter community let fans know he was safe, and Twitter support returned the account that Sunday night. Students have called for him to get an honorary degree. His daily 'Rolf report' still runs: posing with his staff ID card for the Exam Team, or being carried round the uni by his 'American Human' with all four paws dangling.
cats.look: Sleek solid-black short-haired cat with golden-amber eyes, upright pointed ears and a slim, long body (he calls himself 'quite a long cat'); black paws. He wears a yellow reflective collar, and on duty a yellow hi-vis vest printed 'CAMPUS CAT'; his humans hold up his small staff ID card, which has his photo on it.

cats.name: Takeru
cats.owner: His family, who run @takeru0321neko (まつもとたける) and the YouTube channel まつもとたける
cats.story: Takeru is a male Munchkin born on 21 March 2021. His family posts him on X as @takeru0321neko and on the YouTube channel まつもとたける, which shares 'the daily life of our cat Takeru and our family'. On 14 November 2021 they posted a staring, straight-on photo of him captioned 証明写真みたいなの撮れたね ('managed to take something like an ID photo'). Know Your Meme records this photo as the source of the Alien Cat meme. From early 2022 it spread as a reaction image on Twitter, Reddit and Tumblr. Edits followed through 2022: one removed his ears, another removed his nose and gave him completely black eyes like a grey alien, and from late June 2022 a version with even larger alien eyes circulated. In November 2023 the family asked X to explain the meme ('it's singing something, right?'). His bio now calls him the real identity of the singing-cat meme.
cats.look: A white Munchkin (short-legged breed, per his bio) with an all-white coat except for a black cap. A solid black patch covers the crown of his head and runs into the back of his left ear (the viewer's right); his right ear is white with pink inside. His eyes are very large and perfectly round, usually with wide dark pupils inside a thin amber-green ring. He has a small pink nose, long white whiskers and a fluffy white chest. The meme photo is a symmetrical, straight-on staring head-and-chest shot against a pink curtain.

cats.name: Think Think
cats.story: Think Think (蔡想想) is the grey tabby of Tsai Ing-wen, former President of Taiwan. In August 2012 legislator Hsiao Bi-khim found her near Heping Station in Hualien while inspecting damage from Typhoon Saola. Worried the kitten would be run over by relief machinery, she brought her to Tsai's Taipei office, where the thin, muddy kitten promptly peed. Tsai adopted her and named her after the Thinking Taiwan foundation she was setting up. With the ginger tabby Ah Tsai, a farm cat from near a Taitung pineapple field, she starred on campaign souvenirs, and she often joined Tsai when receiving guests. On X, Tsai introduced Philippine Senator Risa Hontiveros to 'my cat Think Think' (May 2023).
cats.look: A grey tabby domestic shorthair with a sturdy, medium build and a weight of about 4.8 kg (zh Wikipedia). Bold charcoal-black mackerel stripes run over a warm silver-grey coat, with the classic tabby 'M' on the forehead, dark stripes on the cheeks and dark rings around the legs and a long tail. Her chest and belly are cream-white. She has large yellow-green eyes, a brick-pink nose and upright ears. In the 2023 photo she wears a small teal tag at her throat.

cats.story: Tsushima (つしま) is the chubby ex-stray cat of the manga Ore, Tsushima (俺、つしま) by the sibling duo Opūnokyōdai. He tells it in his own voice on the manga's X account @tsushimacat, which started in July 2017, and his story posts open 'や、どうも。'. He flops over to demand play and shares the house with Zun-nesan (with Ojii-chan 20+ years), timid, fight-shy Chaa and the neighbourhood cat Osamu. He is modelled on the authors' own brown tabby. His top post (2 Apr 2018) begins the tale of his days as a drifter with nowhere to go. Shogakukan has published 4 volumes (vol. 1 Apr 2018), and a Fanworks/Space Neko Company TV anime aired 3 Jul to 18 Sep 2021, with Akio Otsuka as Tsushima.

He has a broad, flat face, small ears, and heavy-lidded yellow-green eyes in a permanently unimpressed squint. He is usually shown on all fours or sitting like a loaf. There are no accessories, although the 2026 New Year card shows him riding a donkey.

cats.name: Bob
cats.story: Bob is a ginger cat belonging to RAM (@rambites), an artist on X. On 18 March 2022 RAM posted photos of him captioned 'everybody say hi to bob.' Within minutes other accounts, such as @cosmews and @nyavemew, reposted Bob as if he were their own new cat. The joke snowballed until @DieChanc3 posted a roundup of screenshots asking why everyone owned this cat now, and that post went viral. Later that day RAM posted a video of Bob to prove he was really his. Know Your Meme documents the episode as the 'Everyone's Cat' meme. This Bob is not James Bowen's street cat Bob.
cats.look: A young, slim ginger (orange) tabby. He has faint mackerel stripes on his forehead, cheeks and legs, a slightly darker orange stripe along his back, and a cream-white muzzle, chin, throat and chest. His eyes are big, round and copper-amber, with a pink nose and tall ears with pale inner fur. His long orange tail has faint rings. In one photo he wears a thin dark collar. The famous photo is a close, straight-on shot of him lying on grey bedding and staring into the camera.

cats.story: Monkey is a young dilute calico who lives with her owner "Momkey" and housemate Zoe, a calico. Their X account @oreoeocat calls her a "devious/scheming eunuch". cats.name: Prince
cats.owner: Keir Starmer (former UK Prime Minister) and family
cats.story: Prince is the Starmer family's white, blue-eyed Siberian kitten. Instead of the German Shepherd dog the family had talked about during the 2024 election campaign, they agreed on a kitten after 'a long summer of negotiations'. He moved into 10 Downing Street in early September 2024 as the third cat there, alongside the Starmers' rescue cat JoJo and Chief Mouser Larry (BBC). Keir Starmer revealed his name on the BBC's Sunday with Laura Kuenssberg (Independent). The first photo, by Simon Dawson/No 10 Downing Street, shows Prince with his paws on the PM's paperwork (BBC Newsround). Sun on Sunday political editor Kate Ferguson posted it on X on 21 Sep 2024 ('No update yet on how Larry is taking it') and it passed 2.2M views. The parody Larry the Cat account answered: 'My position as best looking cat on Downing Street remains unchallenged'.
cats.look: A fluffy long-haired Siberian kitten, a few months old in the photo, small and round-bodied. The coat is cream-white overall, with faint warm buff/peach shading on the backs of the ears, the forehead and the cheeks (a hint of pale points). Pale pink inner ears with long ear tufts, round blue eyes and a small pink nose. A thick ruff on the chest, bushy fur down the legs, white paws, and a slightly startled stare. He stands on a red leather folder on the PM's desk. Refs: refs/prince_kf_GYB1nNOWAAAQF26.jpg (full official photo), refs/prince_kf_crop.jpg (close-up).

cats.name: Fishtopher
cats.owner: Laura Folts and Tanner Callahan, who adopted him; Folts created @mrfishtopher
cats.story: Fishtopher was a 5-year-old stray at Homeward Bound Pet Adoption Center in Blackwood, New Jersey. His Petfinder listing said he was 'very sad and depressed', would only eat when he had company and 'wouldn't even look up for pictures'. On 24 Nov 2022 @mollyaclarke tweeted 'i swear to god. if one of you doesn't go get fishtopher…', and the post went viral (over 168,000 likes and 21,000 retweets, per NBC News). Laura Folts and Tanner Callahan drove two hours from Baltimore and were first in line to adopt him, and the shelter said 16 other animals were adopted that weekend. His own account, @mrfishtopher ('FIV+ internet cat, animal rescue fan'), shares photos of him at home with his cat friends and promotes other rescues.
cats.look: A big-cheeked brown classic tabby. His warm grey-brown coat has bold black marbled swirls on the flanks and back (his shelter listing said he 'reminds you of a Bengal with his cool coloring'), black stripes and an 'M' on the forehead, striped legs and a dark tail. Green-yellow eyes with droopy, heavy lids gave him his famous sad look. Brick-pink nose, pale chin, long white whiskers and a stocky, heavy build. In recent home photos he looks alert and relaxed beside a black cat and an orange-and-white cat.

Eyes: two hot-pink/red neon X marks (the 'dead' side of dead-or-alive) over a pink-red nebula glow. A soft glowing pink nose and three or four long orange-gold neon whiskers fanning out on each side. cats.story: Jinx is a black cat found in mid-October 2018, three or four weeks old, in a field behind her owner Mia's California home. cats.name: Jjing-jjing

cats.story: Jjing-jjing (찡찡이) was South Korea's first-ever 'first cat' (Korea Herald). Born in January 2005, he was a stray until Da-hye, the future president's daughter, adopted him; in 2007 she passed him to her father, who lived with Kim Jung-sook in Yangsan. He became known in 2012, in her father's first presidential run, when ex-Cultural Heritage Administration head Yoo Hong-joon cited him in a speech on the candidate's caring side. After the May 2017 win, the president brought him to Cheong Wa Dae and tweeted his worry that the cat, who used to surprise the family with dead birds, might go after five baby flycatchers nesting there. On 27 May 2017 he posted photos of Jjing-jjing on his shoulder: the cat still found the place strange but clung to him whenever he watched TV news. He died in June 2024, aged 20; his owner wrote: 'thank you and farewell' (Asia Business Daily).

Pale pinkish-tan inner ears, with a faint brownish tinge at the base of the right ear. A large black saddle patch over the shoulders and back, and a solid black tail he carries upright.

cats.name: Miette
cats.story: Miette is poet and novelist Patricia Lockwood's rescue cat, adopted in October 2015 from the Lawrence, Kansas SPCA after a shelter vet nursed the kitten back to health. Her name means 'little crumb', and she loves tiny snacky crumbs. On 19 March 2019 Lockwood tweeted a scene in Miette's voice: nudged aside with a foot, Miette gasps 'you KICK miette? ... jail for mother for One Thousand Years!!!!' It became a copypasta online, especially on Tumblr, where people wrote about their own cats in Miette's style, and The Guardian later listed it among the best tweets of all time. Lockwood told The Cut that Miette talks like a British orphan and has three games, Rug, Rice and Rat. She told Slate that Miette is too famous to appear in her 2021 novel.
cats.look: Long-haired Ragdoll-type tortie-point with a very plush coat. Creamy white chest, belly and legs; a shaded fawn-beige body with darker seal-brown patches on the flanks and forelegs. Split face: a dark seal-brown mask over one eye and cheek, warm ginger-cream on the other side, and a dark-and-ginger split blaze down the nose to a mottled nose leather. Pale blue eyes. Dark seal-tipped ears with long white ear tufts. A huge feathery tail shading from cream to smoky grey-brown. Soft, floppy 'boneless' build, often belly-up on a sofa or armchair. (Per Lockwood's photos in The Cut, 2019.)

Ponderware broke four years of silence on X: 'Attempting to re-establish contact with the moonbase. Stay Tuned.' There are 25,440 MoonCats: 25,344 Rescue cats, whose colour, expression, pose and fur pattern were chosen by the people who rescued them, plus 96 black or white Genesis cats. Since Oct 2022 MoonCatRescue LLC has run the project.

cats.name: Pépito
cats.owner: Clément Storck (French software engineer, creator of PushingBox) via @PepitoTheCat
cats.story: Pépito is a black cat born in 2007, owned by French software engineer Clément Storck, who built PushingBox, which sends notifications triggered by real-life events. In July 2011 Storck used it to create @PepitoTheCat: a device and a camera watch Pépito's cat flap, and the account auto-posts "Pépito is out" or "Pépito is back home" with a photo and timestamp. When Storck moved to Paris in 2015, Pépito stayed at his parents' house. In June 2017 Storck reassured worried fans that Pépito was asleep at home and 'sometimes uses the human's door'. In February 2023 Elon Musk announced the end of free Twitter API access; Storck protested it would kill the account, and Musk then announced a free, light API for bots that post good content. In March 2024 Storck put a screen on the wall so Pépito can read replies. By September 2026 the account had over 1.1 million followers.

cats.name: Professor Meowingtons PhD
cats.story: Professor Meowingtons PhD was the tuxedo cat of Canadian producer deadmau5 (Joel Zimmerman), named because he meowed a lot: 'meowing tons' (SPIN). Zimmerman adopted him from the Toronto Humane Society in 2009 or 2010. He had his own X account, @meowingtons ('@deadmau5 is my human and this is my official page'), plus Instagram. He appeared on deadmau5 merch, gave his name to the 2011 Meowingtons Hax Tour compilation, and his portrait is on the cover of the 2012 album '>album title goes here<' (We Rave You). Deadmau5 fought a trademark dispute over the Meowingtons name with a cat-goods store, which was resolved in 2018 (Wikipedia). He died in 2023, aged 16 (Wikipedia). In August 2023 deadmau5 posted that he had to help him 'cross the rainbow bridge' (We Rave You). In 2025 deadmau5 released the game 'Meowingtons Simulator', in which players control him (Wikipedia).

cats.name: Sockington
cats.story: Sockington was a grey-and-white shorthair found as a stray outside a Boston subway station in 2004. He lived with archivist Jason Scott in Waltham, Massachusetts. From late 2007 Scott tweeted as him in a breathless cat voice full of shouted capitals. In February 2009 Twitter put @sockington on its recommended list for new users. By May he had half a million followers and The Independent called him 'Twitter's latest megastar'. He passed 1 million in August 2009 and 1.5 million by May 2010, then the most-followed non-human on Twitter. His housemates Pennycat and Tweetie, his 'Sockelganger', tweeted too. He died on 18 July 2022 after 18 years with Scott, who wrote that 'he saw something really shiny in the clouds and decided to chase after it'. Two days later the account posted: 'update I CAUGHT THE RED DOT'.
cats.look: A grey-and-white domestic shorthair: solid slate-grey head, ears, back, legs and tail. A narrow white blaze runs from the forehead down between the eyes and widens over the cat's left side of the nose (viewer's right) onto a white muzzle, giving a lopsided face. White patch on the other cheek too, grey nose leather, white chin, throat and chest. Round amber/yellow-green eyes, upright grey ears, long white whiskers, medium, slightly chunky build. No accessories. His T-shirt (Scott's farewell photo) has his face in a cream-and-gold sunburst medallion under a 'SOCKINGTON' ribbon banner.

cats.name: Mr. B
cats.story: BeeJay, "Mr. B" for short, was a 26-pound, 2-year-old cat at the Morris Animal Refuge in Philadelphia. On 22 August 2019 the shelter posted two photos of a staff member holding him up: "OMG, big boi Mr. B is a CHONK. He's a chonk of a chonk. He redefines the term. Can you guess how much he weighs?" The post now has 35,634 likes and 9,567 reposts; Know Your Meme says it drew more than 40,000 likes and 12,000 retweets in its first 24 hours. CBS Philadelphia reported that the flood of interest crashed the refuge's website that night. The next day, Know Your Meme says, Fox 29 brought him into its studio, where he escaped and hid behind a couch. CBS reported he was described as "a big cat with a big heart", and the shelter called him a "jumbo-sized package of fluff & love".

Bold dark 'M' lines on the forehead, a rust-tan bridge down the nose, brick-pink nose leather, dark-spotted whisker pads, a creamy-white chin and throat and a pale buff belly. Pale blue-grey-green eyes, slightly droopy and 'sad'. Medium upright ears, long white whiskers, thick ringed legs, big paws, and a long, heavy belly that sags when he is held up.

cats.name: Taters
cats.owner: A NASA JPL employee (unnamed); made public by NASA / NASA JPL
cats.story: Taters is an orange tabby, the pet of a NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory employee, and the star of the first ultra-high-definition video streamed by laser from deep space. The 15-second clip of him chasing a red laser-pointer dot across a sofa was loaded onto the Psyche spacecraft before its October 2023 launch. On 11 December 2023 Psyche's flight laser transceiver beamed it from nearly 19 million miles away, about 80 times the Earth-lunar distance, at 267 Mbps, and it reached Earth in 101 seconds via the Hale Telescope at Palomar. On-screen graphics show his heart rate, colour and breed ("TATERS THE CAT", "ORANGE TABBY"). NASA's X post of the video has 1.97M views, and in April 2025 NASA JPL said Taters and the video were nominated for a Webby Award.
cats.look: A real cat: a ginger tabby-and-white shorthair, solid and slightly chunky. Warm orange coat, soft darker-orange tabby stripes on head, back and flanks, faint forehead 'M' stripes and a long striped, plume-like tail. White muzzle, chin, throat, chest and front legs/paws, running up the face sides. Pink nose, upright pink-lined ears, long white whiskers. Pale amber-green eyes with blue-teal video reflections. Filmed on a dark navy-grey sofa under a sci-fi HUD: mirrored 'THIS IS A TEST' banner, target rings, BPM readout, 'SUBJECT:: TATERS THE CAT / SPECIES:: ORANGE TABBY / LIFE:: 5/9'.

proof.text: We just streamed the first ultra-HD video brought to you via laser from deep space. And it’s a video of Taters, a tabby cat. This test will pave the way for high-data-rate communications in support of the next giant leap: sending humans to Mars.

cats.story: Endou Heizou (遠藤平蔵) is the Night-Patrol Cat of Kaoru Fukaya's eight-panel manga Yomawari Neko. He is a grey stray who wears a cat-food can on his head and a hanten jacket. Every night he walks the town calling "Are there any crying children?" (泣く子はいねがー), and when he catches "the scent of tears" he appears to listen or give advice. He usually carries the tiger-striped kitten Juurou (重郎). Fukaya posted the first strip to Twitter on 22 October 2015, and retweets by Saho Yamamoto and Shigesato Itoi spread it. His name comes from the surname of a couple Fukaya knows and their cat's name. The series won the 21st Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize (Short Story Award) and became an NHK anime in March 2023, with Takayuki Yamada as Heizou. It has passed 700,000 copies, and volume 12 came out from Kodansha on 22 May 2026.
cats.look: Hand-drawn black-and-white manga style in pen and pencil/marker with grey tone shading (early strips: freehand sign pen on B5 copy paper). Heizou is a stout, round-headed grey stray cat shaded mid-to-dark grey, on all four legs like a real cat, with two upright pointed ears and a long thin tail. Narrow, half-lidded eyes glance sideways for a deadpan, world-weary look, sometimes with faint blush on his cheeks. An upturned white cat-food can marked 缶 sits on his head like a little hat. He wears a thick hanten (padded Japanese jacket) with vertical stripes and a dark collar band.

("Yoshi!", "All good!") like a worksite safety check, often over plainly unsafe work in the fan collages. It took off on pixiv in early 2018 and on Twitter by August 2018. In a November 2019 X post Kumamine explained that the collages were already called Yoshi Neko or Genba Neko, so taking the name would be greedy; Kumamine's own version became 仕事猫 (Shigoto Neko). Official goods followed: Don Quijote collaborations, a free 2025 LINEMO sticker set and 2026 Capcom keychains sold early at Tokyo Game Show. A costumed Shigoto Neko now appears at events.

cats.name: Hodge
cats.owner: Samuel Johnson; remembered by Dr Johnson's House museum, 17 Gough Square, London (@drjohnsonshouse)
cats.story: Hodge was the favourite cat of Samuel Johnson, known mainly from James Boswell's 1791 biography. Johnson went out himself to buy oysters for Hodge, 'lest the servants having that trouble should take a dislike to the poor creature', and told Boswell: 'he is a very fine cat, a very fine cat indeed.' A 1778 elegy mentions his 'sable fur'. Jon Bickley's bronze statue, unveiled by the Lord Mayor of London in 1997 outside Johnson's house in Gough Square, shows Hodge on Johnson's Dictionary beside empty oyster shells. The museum, where the Dictionary was written, still posts about 'the finest cat in Gough Square'.
cats.look: Known today from Jon Bickley's bronze statue: a slim, upright short-haired cat sitting on a large book (Johnson's Dictionary) beside two oyster shells, with large pointed ears, half-closed eyes and a long tail curled round the front paws. In life a black cat ('sable fur').

cats.story: On 18 January 1988 librarian Vicki Myron found an eight-week-old kitten in the Spencer Public Library's drop box. cats.name: Hodge
cats.story: Hodge is the resident cat of Southwark Cathedral in London. He came from the Catcuddles Sanctuary in Bexley, where a woman had brought him after spotting a cat with a facial deformity on her way to work; the swelling turned out not to be cancerous and was treated with antibiotics. Then two years old, he arrived at the cathedral in autumn 2020, by coincidence on the same day that the former cathedral cat Doorkins Magnificat died, and was introduced to the congregation after the Sunday Choral Eucharist in December 2020. He shares his name with Dr Samuel Johnson's cat. English Cathedrals calls him Chief Mouser at Southwark Cathedral. He has his own X account, the cathedral hosts a 'Hodge presents Stories of Cats' day, and the cathedral shop sells a Hodge the Cat 2027 calendar.
cats.look: Black-and-white tuxedo cat: glossy black back, head and tail; white muzzle and blaze up the nose, white bib/chest and white front paws; pink nose, long white whiskers, green eyes, upright black ears; medium build; wears a thin collar.

cats.name: Simpkin IV
cats.story: Simpkin is the name of the resident cat at Hertford College, Oxford, a tradition started in the early 1970s by principal Geoffrey Warnock, with each cat named after a Beatrix Potter character. Simpkin IV, originally called Buddy and found as a stray in the Torbay area, joined Hertford in January 2017; unlike his black-and-white predecessors he is entirely black. The college lists him as staff with 'overall management responsibility' and an office in the Lodge. In January 2022 Exeter College banned him from its library with a sign reading 'He is called Simpkin and belongs at Hertford! WARNING: HE BITES!', prompting Principal Tom Fletcher to call it 'a breach of international convention'. The Bodleian Libraries later reported spotting him in the Clarendon Building.
cats.look: Solid black all over (no white markings), medium-length slightly fluffy coat, compact build, yellow-amber eyes (eye colour from the Exeter library sign photo - verify with photos).

cats.story: Milko (ミルコ) is a male white cat in Japan, famous online as the 'zero-gravity cat' (無重力猫) because so many of his photos catch him flying through the air. He was rescued as a kitten after being abandoned, crying, in a company parking lot, badly underweight, and nursed back to health. His owner, writer Chisa Nakagawa, named him after a fighter so he would grow up strong. As a kitten he had dark marks on his head that faded until he was pure white. His jumping photos led to TV appearances and photo books, starting with 'Mujuryoku Neko Tobikkiri Milko!' (announced 2016). The account @ccchisa76 (about 141k followers) shares Milko and his housemates. On 28 Aug 2026 it marked his 11th anniversary as a house cat.

cats.name: Pawfficer Donut
cats.story: Pawfficer Donut is the police cat of the Troy Police Department in suburban Detroit, Michigan. The department pledged to add a cat if its Twitter account reached 10,000 followers, and it went from 4,000 to 10,000 in eight days. Donut was sworn in by a judge on May 11, 2018, for the department's Feline Unit, which is meant for therapeutic purposes and public appearances. Proceeds from Troy Police Feline Unit merchandise go to the Michigan Humane Society. She became a regular on the department's X account, where her 'Caturday' posts ask people to drive sober, stop texting at the wheel and be civil to each other.
cats.look: Grey (blue-silver) tabby with darker grey stripes and markings, a white chin, chest and bib, large green eyes, upright ears and a pinkish-brown nose. Medium build. The department's photos carry a 'Troy Police Feline Unit' watermark.

cats.name: Harry
cats.story: Harry is the resident cat of Burwood Hospital in Christchurch, New Zealand. He once belonged to a family who lived nearby, and at about three years old he decided the hospital was more fun than home. The family then officially gifted him to the hospital. He greets staff at the spinal ward doors at shift change, goes to Occupational Therapy for breakfast and does patient rounds. Staff say he calms patients recovering from mental health issues, and he never hisses or bites. His birthday is 14 September. For his 12th (2023) he got tuna, cards and fan mail from all over the country. His photo calendar sold out five years running, and its profits go into his own bank account (1News).
cats.look: Fluffy long-haired black cat with a small white chin and bib patch, white-tipped front paws, a rusty-brown tinge to the long chest fur, yellow-green eyes and long white whiskers. Large and heavy (about 8 kg per 1News).

cats.name: Don Gato
cats.story: Don Gato was the black cat of Spanish YouTuber and Twitch streamer AuronPlay (Raúl Álvarez Genes), one of the most-followed Spanish-language creators. He was a familiar presence in AuronPlay's life for 8 years. In April 2021 AuronPlay told fans that Don Gato had been hospitalised with a suspected liver problem, and he posted updates from the vet. Don Gato died on 26 April 2021. AuronPlay thanked him "for these 8 years" and thanked the veterinary team. Colombian outlets El Heraldo and Noticias Caracol reported the loss. When AuronPlay adopted his next cat, Lukas, in July 2021, he wrote that if Lukas gave half the love Don Gato gave, he would be the best cat in the world.

cats.name: Guppy
cats.story: Guppy was the cat of game developer Edmund McMillen (Super Meat Boy, The Binding of Isaac, Mewgenics) and his wife Danielle. McMillen got him while working animal control for the SPCA (now the Santa Cruz County animal shelter) and says 19 August was the day they found Guppy abandoned in a planter box. In McMillen's words, Guppy hated people, was scared of the outdoors, and made unbroken eye contact. He was "extremely loving to us" and lay his head on McMillen's arm while he made most of his games. Guppy died in August 2014 after 12 years with the family. He lives on in The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth through items such as Guppy's Collar.

cats.story: The Bear was the cat behind @MYSADCAT, a UK X account (about 192k followers) known for photos captioned 'My cat is sad because...'. Tom Cox set it up to promote his books about The Bear, who appears in six of them. The Guardian reported that he was found in a plastic bag on the hard shoulder of a motorway with several siblings, and that he was named for looking like a teddy bear. Cox called him 'the most polite cat I have ever met', a cat who asked for food by nodding toward the cupboard. He lived through flea allergies, carbon monoxide poisoning and an attack by feral cats. Fans called themselves 'The Bear's Army'. He turned 20 in October 2015.

His family gave him to the Takahashi Tourism Association, and he was formally installed as castle lord on 16 December 2018. He is named after Tani Sanjuro, a samurai from the Bitchu Matsuyama domain. He is credited with helping bring visitors back after the disaster, and the Okayama Tourism Association gave him an award in June 2020. On 29 July 2026 he was made a one-day traffic-safety ambassador for the Okayama Prefectural Police. KSB put his age at about 11.

cats.name: Kuronosuke (黑の助)
cats.story: Kuronosuke is the 'garden-keeper cat' (お庭番ねこ) of the Yumeji Art Museum in Okayama, a museum devoted to the painter Takehisa Yumeji. A staff member rescued him as a kitten from traffic near Shintsurumi Bridge a few days before 1 September 2016, the anniversary of Yumeji's death. The museum named him after Yumeji's eldest son, Konosuke, and appointed him on 24 December 2016. His eyes match the black cat in Yumeji's illustrated 'Cat Booklet'. He has since been promoted to head garden keeper; the historian Michifumi Isoda wrote his letter of appointment in an old-document style, and it is displayed beside his office. He comes to work when he likes, and the museum posts 'Kuronosuke has arrived for work!' on the days he does. There are also a Kuronosuke mascot, a calendar, cards and an afternoon tea in his name. 2026 marks ten years since he took the job.

cats.name: Hadji
cats.story: Hadji was the cat of Keith Hernandez, the former Mets first baseman who became an SNY broadcaster. Hernandez often worked Hadji stories into his Mets broadcasts and posted him on X: helping with jigsaw puzzles, lounging on the terrace and posing with a birthday cake. cats.name: Pawfficer Fuzz
cats.story: Pawfficer Fuzz is the police cat of the Fort Smith Police Department in Arkansas. In September 2019 the department chose him from about five rescue kittens at Jen's Kitty Rehab, a local nonprofit, and introduced him as the newest member of its team. More than 5,800 votes in a public poll picked his name, and on 24 October 2019 Mayor George McGill swore him in as an ambassador of the city. The program was inspired by Troy, Michigan's Pawfficer Donut. His job is to make the police more approachable. He visits schools, libraries, churches, nursing homes and community events, and he promotes adoption and spaying/neutering. He has been featured on Hallmark's Home and Family and in American Police Beat magazine. Since October 2023 the department has released a children's story series, The Adventures of Pawfficer Fuzz; 'Pawfficer Fuzz and the First-Day Jitters' came out in August 2024.

cats.owner: Her owner in Japan (not named publicly), who runs @shiroan_chan (しろあん🐾でっかい北欧猫) and a YouTube channel
cats.story: Shiroan (しろあん) is a female Norwegian Forest Cat from Japan, born on 1 April 2022 and adopted as a kitten on 28 May 2022. Her owner started @shiroan_chan to share her cuteness with the world; it now has about 108,000 followers. In April 2023 AppBank reported that a photo of the 10-month-old covering her owner's whole upper body went viral (she was 5.2 kg then). In May 2023 Kobe Shimbun covered selfies she took on the owner's phone, and in December 2023 a typo giving her weight as '706kg' (really 7.6 kg) went viral too. In March 2025 ABEMA Morning showed how her long coat makes her stretch out when lifted, shrink into a ball on a chair and once wedge into a perfect square ('cats really are liquid'). On her third birthday her owner called her the 'unbelievably big' cat born on April Fools' Day; her profile now lists 9.2 kg. She greets her owner with loud meows and asks to be held.
cats.look: Very large, long-haired Norwegian Forest Cat (female, about 9 kg). Brown/golden tabby with white: brown mackerel-tabby head with a white muzzle, blaze and chin, pink nose, big yellow-green eyes, tall ears with lynx tufts. Thick white bib and chest ruff; tabby-barred forelegs ending in white mitten paws with pink pads; shaggy buff-gold flanks and fluffy britches; huge bushy brown tabby tail.

cats.name: Oage
cats.owner: Her owner in Japan (not named publicly), who runs @oage_cat on X and Instagram
cats.story: Oage (おあげ) is a calico British Shorthair girl from Japan, born on 17 November 2021 and named for her 'tasty-looking' calico colours; she posts as @oage_cat (about 76,000 followers). She first went viral in May 2022 at five months old: a video of her leaping from a table toward a window ledge and falling short drew over 290,000 likes and 3.8 million views. Her owner told Maido News (Kobe Shimbun) she was not hurt and is a curious, sociable girl who loves toy mice. In January 2023 a clip of her losing a hair tie on her own leg went viral too. AppBank said her black, orange and white coat is compared to a Persian carpet (viewers also saw tiramisu), and a January 2026 photo of her back, captioned 'the cat a friend said looks like a luxury rug', passed 100,000 likes.
cats.look: Calico (black, orange and white) British Shorthair female with a very dense, plush short coat and a stocky, round body. Broad round face: black patches over both eyes and ears with an orange blaze up the forehead between them, an orange patch across the muzzle under a small pink-tan nose, large golden-yellow eyes, small rounded ears. White chin, chest, belly, legs and paws; back and flanks in big black and orange patches; black-and-orange tail. Often looks stern.

cats.name: Anko
cats.owner: His owner in Japan (not named publicly), who runs @cat_anko3 (あんこともなか🐾充電ねこ)
cats.story: Anko (あんこ) is a silver-tabby American Shorthair tom from Japan, born on 31 August 2019. He shares the account @cat_anko3, 'Anko & Monaka, the charging cat' (about 83,000 followers), with Monaka, a younger straight-eared Scottish. On 23 January 2023 his owner posted 'I came home and the cat was charging from his bottom': Anko loafing on the sofa, eyes shut, with a white cable trailing out behind him. AppBank reported 138,000 likes four days later (the post now shows about 188,000). In July 2022 Daily Sports (Maido News) covered his 'sleep switch' under the chin: stroke it and he dozes off, even shifting his face so the right spot gets rubbed. His owner says his hobbies are hide-and-seek and following his human around, and in early 2023 his favourite sleeping pose was the face-down 'gomen-ne'.
cats.look: Silver classic-tabby American Shorthair male of medium, sturdy build. Pale silver-grey coat with bold black swirled tabby markings on the sides, black stripes down the back, a black 'M' and fine lines on the forehead, black necklace bands across a whitish-silver chest and barred legs. Large round green eyes, brick-pink nose, whitish muzzle and chin, pale paws; round cheeks (rounder in his winter coat).
